_note: §5 force-to-C: commodity / universal-infrastructure tools & methods that carry no scholar-specific signal. They stay disposition=method_tool but are demoted to salience C (never a family, never an exemplar, excluded from the counts that drive ranking). Matched whole-word against the canonical display_name. NARROWER than the #169 suppress_list on purpose: items the v3 classifier spec treats as legitimate records are intentionally OMITTED here and get their salience decided at A2 instead of being force-C'd — bibliographic DBs (PubMed/EMBASE -> datasets_cohorts, spec §1.10), platforms (REDCap -> software_informatics, §1.11/§6.2), and named assays (ELISA -> clinical_instruments_assays, §1.6). Comparators (placebo) and generic instruments/methods stay. Operator-reviewable.
